# KYNX Luau component manifest

Upstream: https://github.com/luau-lang/luau
Ref: master (fetched on demand)
License: MIT (see upstream LICENSE.txt)

Current upstream bytecode definition: v3-v14.

KYNX does not copy the entire upstream repository into every release archive because it is a live upstream project. The fetch script makes the integration reproducible from the official repository.
